# ProAppStore Platform Docs

> Developer documentation and knowledge base for ProAppStore (https://proappstore.online), the paid app marketplace on Cloudflare Workers + D1: SDK, CLI, architecture, security model, and the clause-numbered Recommended Application Standard that says how an app should use the platform and how a human or an AI copilot audits one. The storefront's own index is at https://proappstore.online/llms.txt; the AI agent guide is https://proappstore.online/skills.md.

## Agent Skills (workflows for AI clients)

- [create-proappstore-app](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/create-proappstore-app/SKILL.md): Open Agent Skills workflow to create, scaffold and provision a new ProAppStore app through the MCP server — gather inputs, pick an approved template, dry-run `provision_pas_app`, confirm, provision, verify. Index: [skills/README.md](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/README.md).
- [choose-proappstore-architecture](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/choose-proappstore-architecture/SKILL.md): read-only Agent Skill to choose the architecture and platform services for a ProAppStore app — maps each requirement to the platform primitive (registered actions on D1, `app.kv`, `app.counters`, `app.storage`, `app.rooms`, `app.roles`, the proxy and integrations), names unsupported needs with the interim pattern, explains trade-offs, and produces a bounded decision citing the Application Standard.
- [proappstore-auth-sessions-roles](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/proappstore-auth-sessions-roles/SKILL.md): read-only Agent Skill to add or correct authentication, cookie sessions, roles and permissions in a ProAppStore app — platform-cookie sessions, `app.auth` sign-in/sign-out/hydration, `app.roles` with `auth.app_roles` manifest gates and SQL scoping, a gated permissions UI, negative authorization tests; detects and remediates storage-held sessions, `app.auth.token` coupling, home-grown sign-in tables, membership-only gates, unsafe return URLs and incomplete sign-out, citing the AUTH chapter of the Application Standard.
- [proappstore-data-migrations-actions](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/proappstore-data-migrations-actions/SKILL.md): read-only Agent Skill to design or correct a ProAppStore app's data layer — D1 vs `app.kv` / `app.storage` / `app.counters` / `app.rooms`, additive `migrations.json`, `mcp.json` registered actions with declared typed params and the server-owned `:__user_id` / `:__now` / `:__uuid`, SQL scoping and write invariants, atomic batches, idempotent writes, negative authorization tests, migration verification and deployment checks; detects cross-tenant access, guessed identifiers, replayable grants, unsafe writes and migration/action drift, citing the DATA chapter of the Application Standard.
- [proappstore-publish-deploy](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/proappstore-publish-deploy/SKILL.md): Agent Skill to publish, deploy, verify and roll back a ProAppStore app through the supported path — preconditions and repository policy, the canonical gates (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pas check`), inspection of the migrations and registered actions a release applies, a preview of consequential changes, push-to-main deploy via the keyless OIDC workflow, `deploy_status` / `schema_status` / `discover_tools` / QA-run monitoring, stale-asset check, the evidence bundle, idempotent retry, partial-deployment recovery and `git revert` rollback, citing the OPS chapter of the Application Standard. Read-only MCP tools plus `qa_run`.
- [proappstore-upgrade-app](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/proappstore-upgrade-app/SKILL.md): read-only Agent Skill to upgrade an existing ProAppStore app to the current SDK, template and Application Standard without overwriting its product code — inventory, comparison with the catalogue baseline (`list_templates`: SDK/CLI/Node/pnpm, reviewed template revision, known deviations) and the canonical workflows, template drift, and a staged plan (toolchain, SDK and CLI, workflows, platform-cookie migration, registered actions and migrations, UI/PWA baseline, MCP tools, tests) with a dry-run report by default, bounded one-stage implementation, explicit review before destructive or broad changes, and per-stage `git revert` rollback.

- [audit-proappstore-app](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/audit-proappstore-app/SKILL.md): read-only Agent Skill to audit a ProAppStore app against the current public Application Standard — fetches `standard.json` and the finding contract, decides applicability clause by clause, applies the published direct rules, emits pass / fail / not-applicable / manual-review findings with clause URL, file:line evidence, impact, bounded remediation, acceptance tests, confidence, human-validation flag and dedupe key; issue creation only when asked, after a duplicate check.
- [Plugin](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/.claude-plugin/plugin.json) and [discovery manifest](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/marketplace.json): the seven skills packaged with the MCP endpoint; per-client install / update / uninstall steps (Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add proappstore-online/platform`); checksums in [skills/index.json](https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/index.json).
- [Agent Skills evaluation summary](https://docs.proappstore.online/skills/evaluations/): what every skill is evaluated for (triggering, non-triggering, tool order, dry-run/confirmation, output schema, idempotency, failure recovery, citation accuracy, secret safety, context size), per-skill case counts and budgets, the release gate, and the supported-client smoke evidence still pending #169. Manifest with checksums: https://github.com/proappstore-online/platform/blob/main/skills/index.json

## Application Standard (audit an app)

- [Standard — overview and audit guide](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/): What the standard is, recommendation vs enforcement vs optional capability, the six-step audit procedure, chapter map.
- [Audit instructions](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/audit-instructions/): The reusable, tool-agnostic procedure an AI or a person follows to audit a repository and emit findings. Start here to audit.
- [standard.json](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/standard.json): Every clause as data — id, stable URL, severity, verification class, enforcement, and all ten template sections. Validated by [standard.schema.json](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/standard.schema.json).
- [finding.schema.json](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/finding.schema.json): The finding and audit-report contract (state, severity, evidence with file:line, impact, bounded remediation, acceptance tests, confidence, human-validation flag, deduplication key). Example: [audit.example.json](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/examples/audit.example.json).
- [llms-full.txt](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/llms-full.txt): The full text of every clause in one plain-text file.
- [compliance-checks.json](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/compliance-checks.json): Every `pas check` id mapped to the clauses it cites, with automation level and limits. Schema: [compliance-checks.schema.json](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/compliance-checks.schema.json). Automated checks are hygiene scans, not a security audit — see [automation levels](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/audit-model/#automation-levels).
- [Audit model](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/audit-model/): Applicability, evidence classes, verification classes, result states, severity levels, finding fields.
- [Governance and versioning](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/governance/): Chapter taxonomy, clause-ID grammar and anchors, MUST/SHOULD/MAY, clause template, versioning, withdrawals.
- [Changelog](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/changelog/): One entry per standard version.

### Chapters

- [STACK — stack and platform services](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/stack/): Which platform primitive to use for each need; the decision tree.
- [AUTH — identity, sessions, and permissions](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/auth/): Platform-cookie auth, no app-managed tokens, RBAC scopes, permissions UI.
- [DATA — data, actions, and Workers](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/data/): Migrations, registered actions, SQL row scoping, KV/D1/storage/counters/rooms, service bindings.
- [UI — UI, browser security, and PWA](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/ui/): Components and tokens, accessibility, responsive, CSP/XSS/uploads/framing, service worker and PWA.
- [OPS — testing, deployment, and operations](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/ops/): Tests, CI, keyless deploy, secrets, rollback, logging, monitoring, privacy, incident evidence.
- [INT — integrations and platform services](https://docs.proappstore.online/standard/integrations/): Proxy/secrets, AI, maps, notifications, email/SMS, subscriptions, MCP (clauses pending).

## Platform docs

- [Getting started](https://docs.proappstore.online/getting-started/): Quick start, tech stack, monorepo layout.
- [SDK overview](https://docs.proappstore.online/sdk-overview/): initPro, every SDK surface, monitoring, auth session storage.
- [UI components](https://docs.proappstore.online/ui/): ProShell, composable components, hooks, design tokens.
- [Recipes](https://docs.proappstore.online/recipes/): CRUD, forms, tables, UI patterns, SDK features.
- [CLI overview](https://docs.proappstore.online/cli-overview/): pas create / check / publish / secret / proxy / domain.
- [Publishing flow](https://docs.proappstore.online/publishing-flow/): Provisioning sequence, key properties, failure modes.
- [Approved templates](https://docs.proappstore.online/templates/): The governed template catalogue and selection contract; data at [templates/catalogue.json](https://docs.proappstore.online/templates/catalogue.json) (schema: [catalogue.schema.json](https://docs.proappstore.online/templates/catalogue.schema.json)). Unknown templates are refused; the copied source commit is recorded per app.
- [MCP app tools](https://docs.proappstore.online/mcp-app-tools/): The mcp.json manifest, auth model, validation rules, security model.
- [App actions and data access security](https://docs.proappstore.online/app-actions-security/): Guard idioms — the SQL is the security boundary; batch tools; registration and drift.
- [Architecture](https://docs.proappstore.online/architecture/): Control plane, worker-to-worker pattern (service bindings are mandatory), databases.
- [Browser auth session model](https://docs.proappstore.online/auth-session-model/): Platform-cookie token handler, custom domains, app author rules.
- [Authorization model](https://docs.proappstore.online/authorization-model/): The three role scopes and which check to use.
- [Build and deploy](https://docs.proappstore.online/build-and-deploy/): Per-repo keyless workflow → R2 → host worker.
- [Monitoring runbook](https://docs.proappstore.online/monitoring-runbook/): Signals, triage, thresholds.
- [Migration repair runbook](https://docs.proappstore.online/migration-repair-runbook/): Detect, interpret, repair schema drift.
- [ADRs](https://docs.proappstore.online/adr/001-cloudflare-workers-only/): Architecture decision records.
